General waste

label.en: Assume it belongs in recycling

prompt.en: You buy spinach, then find an unopened bag at home. Which habit could prevent this?
prompt.zh: 买回菠菜后才发现家里已有一袋未打开的。哪个习惯能帮助避免？

label.en: Buy only products with longer shelf-life labels
label.zh: 只买标示保质期更长的产品

label.en: Check existing food before shopping
Buy a larger bag next time

explanation.en: An inventory check helps match purchases to what is actually needed.
explanation.zh: 查看库存有助于让购买量符合实际需要。

serviceAssumptions.en: No local disposal instruction is implied.
serviceAssumptions.zh: 本题不代表当地投放指引。

prompt.en: Food is repeatedly forgotten behind newer groceries. Which change helps?
prompt.zh: 食物总被新买的东西挡住、遗忘。哪种调整有帮助？

label.en: Keep soon-needed food visible
label.zh: 让近期需使用的食物可见

label.en: Move older food further back
Replace the item before checking its date
label.zh: 查看日期前就先买替代品

explanation.en: A visible use-first area makes it easier to plan around existing food.
explanation.zh: 可见的优先使用区让你更容易用已有食物安排餐食。

prompt.zh: 为什么避免可食用食物被浪费与气候行动有关？

label.en: It affects only disposal, not production inputs
label.zh: 只涉及丢弃，不涉及生产投入

label.en: Food production has no climate link
label.zh: 食物生产与气候没有联系

label.en: It avoids wasting production resources too
label.zh: 也避免浪费生产投入的资源

explanation.zh: 生产和供应食物需要资源。预防浪费也关注这些投入。

serviceAssumptions.en: No local disposal instruction is implied.

label.en: Automatic measurement of personal emissions
Climate education and awareness
It measures the climate impact of each answer
label.zh: 它测量每次回答的气候影响

explanation.en: Target 13.3 includes climate education and awareness; a pass is a learning result.
explanation.zh: 13.3 包含气候教育与意识提升；通过测验代表学习成果。

label.zh: 只按最大部件的说明处理

label.en: Send both to packaging recycling

label.zh: 只按容器外部材料分类

label.en: Separate food from packaging

explanation.en: Food and its container are different components; follow the appropriate route for each.
explanation.zh: 食物与容器是不同组成部分，应分别按各自规则处理。

label.zh: 遵循指定的准备或收集要求

Packed with leftover food
Empty and loose, without a plastic bag
label.zh: 倒空后散放，不装塑料袋

label.zh: 用额外塑料把食物封在里面

A food-soiled paper towel

label.zh: 不必去掉，包装会和食物一起分解

label.en: Add a bag to keep the peel contained

label.zh: 无视说明投入混合回收

label.en: Yes, if it is unbroken and empty
label.zh: 可以，只要它完整且已倒空

label.en: No; check the disposal route for that item
label.zh: 不可以；查看该物品的处理方式

label.zh: 可以，所有玻璃的收集方式相同

explanation.zh: 耐热玻璃器具不同于瓶罐玻璃，不适合瓶罐回收流。

prompt.en: You already own a usable reusable shopping bag. Which action avoids more single-use waste?
prompt.zh: 你已有一个可用的购物袋。哪种做法能减少一次性废弃物？

label.en: Bring it and use it again
Buy a new reusable bag every trip
label.zh: 每次购物都买一个新环保袋

label.en: Leave it at home and take a new checkout bag
label.zh: 把它留在家里，结账时另拿购物袋

explanation.en: Repeated use makes the reusable item replace additional single-use items.
explanation.zh: 反复使用才能让可重复使用物品替代更多一次性物品。

serviceAssumptions.zh: 本题不代表当地投放指引。

prompt.en: When reusing a container for food, what matters most?
prompt.zh: 将容器重复用于盛装食物时，最重要的是什么？

label.en: It looks attractive, regardless of previous contents
label.zh: 外观漂亮即可，不看原先装什么

label.en: A rinse makes any container suitable for food
label.zh: 冲洗一下就能让任何容器适合盛装食品

label.en: It is clean and suitable for that food use
label.zh: 它干净且适合这种食品用途

explanation.en: Reuse must be safe and suitable; avoid repurposing containers into unsafe uses.
explanation.zh: 重复使用应安全、合适，不能让容器承担不安全的用途。

label.en: It removes the need to check local services
label.zh: 不再需要查看当地服务

label.en: It reduces broken glass contaminating paper and plastic
label.zh: 减少碎玻璃混入纸类与塑料

label.en: It counts every jar as a new product immediately
label.zh: 立即把每个罐子算成新产品

explanation.en: A cleaner stream makes recovery easier; separation itself is not proof a new product was made.
explanation.zh: 更干净的收集流有助于回收；完成分离不等于已经制成新产品。

serviceAssumptions.en: Victoria teaching example. Follow the stated service conditions; local council rules may differ.
serviceAssumptions.zh: Victoria 教学示例。按题目说明的服务条件判断；各 council 规则可能不同。

prompt.zh: 你不再需要一个可重复使用的饭盒。哪种再利用方式合适？

label.en: Offer it only if clean, safe and usable
label.zh: 只在干净、安全、可用时转给别人

label.en: Donate it even if damaged and unsafe
Place it in mixed recycling without checking
label.zh: 不核对就投入混合回收

explanation.en: Only pass on items suitable for someone else to use.
explanation.zh: 只应转交适合他人继续使用的物品。

serviceAssumptions.zh: 本题不代表当地投放指引。

prompt.zh: 写购物清单前，哪项检查最能避免重复购买？

label.en: Check only discounts
List replacements from memory
label.zh: 凭记忆列出要补买的食物

label.en: Check fridge, freezer and pantry
label.zh: 查看冰箱、冷冻室和储物柜

explanation.en: A stocktake across storage areas reveals what you already have.
explanation.zh: 查看各储存区域能了解已有食物。

serviceAssumptions.en: A teaching scenario; no personal emissions saving or council service is assumed.
serviceAssumptions.zh: 教学情景；不预设个人减排量或当地收集服务。

label.zh: 先吃完全部新买的食物再考虑

label.en: Choose a meal using those vegetables
label.zh: 选择能用到这些蔬菜的一餐

explanation.zh: 围绕已有食材计划餐食，能减少遗忘。

label.zh: 按实际就餐人数调整份量

label.en: Cook the usual portions with no leftover plan
label.zh: 照常做且不安排剩菜用途

label.en: Add extra portions because ingredients are available

explanation.en: Matching portions to attendance helps avoid unwanted leftovers.
explanation.zh: 按就餐人数安排份量，有助于避免多余剩菜。

explanation.en: A lower unit price does not make unused food useful; plan quantities you can use.
explanation.zh: 单价低不等于食物能被用掉，应按可使用的数量购买。

prompt.en: A recipe uses half a tub of an ingredient. What makes a useful plan for the remainder?

label.en: Leave it unlabelled at the back

label.zh: 在安全储存期限内安排另一餐使用

explanation.en: Linking meals around shared ingredients gives the remainder a purpose.
explanation.zh: 让不同餐食共用食材，可为剩余部分安排用途。

prompt.en: Your week's plans change after shopping. What is the best next step?
prompt.zh: 购物后本周安排改变了。下一步怎样做最好？

label.zh: 查看易腐食物，调整餐食或安全储存安排

label.en: Keep the original plan without checking food

label.zh: 还没看已有食物就重新购物

explanation.zh: 安排改变时，灵活调整能让已有食物继续被关注。

prompt.en: A food is past its use-by date. It smells normal. What should you do?
prompt.zh: 食物已过 use-by 日期，但闻起来正常。应该怎么办？

label.en: Use smell alone to decide it is safe
Cook it longer to override the date
label.zh: 延长烹饪时间以替代日期限制

label.en: Do not eat it

explanation.en: Use-by is a safety limit. Smell does not override it.
explanation.zh: Use-by 是安全期限，气味不能替代这一限制。

label.en: The day the pack was opened
Expected food quality
The same safety cutoff as use-by
label.zh: 与 use-by 相同的安全截止

explanation.en: Best-before concerns quality. Storage instructions and food condition still matter.
explanation.zh: Best-before 主要涉及品质，仍需注意储存说明和食物状态。

label.en: Follow that storage instruction
Use the date alone regardless of storage
Keep it on the counter to remember it
label.zh: 为了记得使用而放在室温台面

explanation.en: Date marks rely on appropriate storage; follow the product's instructions.
explanation.zh: 日期标记以适当储存为前提，应遵循产品说明。

label.en: At room temperature all day
Move it to a warm spot to speed thawing
In the fridge or using a microwave
label.zh: 在冰箱里或使用微波炉

explanation.en: Avoid room-temperature thawing; use the fridge or microwave as instructed.
explanation.zh: 避免室温解冻，按指引使用冰箱或微波炉。

prompt.en: You can either buy less surplus food or improve sorting of the surplus later. Which prevents the waste first?
prompt.zh: 可以少买多余食物，也可以事后更好地分类多余食物。哪项先预防浪费？

label.en: Change the surplus food's packaging
Buy only what you can use
Buy the surplus and sort it later

explanation.en: Prevention avoids creating the surplus; sorting deals with it after it exists.
explanation.zh: 预防减少多余食物的产生；分类是在产生之后处理。

prompt.en: Which is a sensible way to reduce packaging waste at lunch?
prompt.zh: 哪种做法能合理减少午餐包装废弃物？

label.en: Use an existing clean, food-suitable reusable container
label.zh: 使用已有、干净、适合食品的可重复使用容器

label.en: Rinse any available container without checking food suitability
label.zh: 冲洗任意现有容器，不查看是否适合盛装食品

label.en: Buy single-use packs labelled recyclable for each lunch
label.zh: 每餐购买标有可回收的一次性包装

explanation.en: Useful reuse combines repeated use with safety and suitability.
explanation.zh: 有效再利用兼顾重复使用、安全和适用性。

prompt.en: What can a suitable FOGO service do for unavoidable food scraps?
prompt.zh: 合适的 FOGO 服务可以怎样处理无法避免的食物残余？

label.en: Collect all food packaging with the scraps
label.zh: 将所有食品包装与残余一起收集

label.en: Replace meal planning by composting unused food
label.zh: 将未用食物堆肥，以此替代餐食计划

label.en: Collect them for composting

explanation.en: Organics collection helps handle scraps, while avoiding edible waste remains a separate goal.
explanation.zh: 有机物收集有助于处理残余；避免可食用食物浪费仍是另一项目标。

label.en: Treat usable food and packaging as one waste item
label.zh: 把可用食物与包装当成同一废弃物

label.en: Use edible ingredients, then check an accepted route for scraps
label.zh: 先使用可食用食材，再核对残余的接收方式

label.en: Send usable ingredients and scraps directly to compost
label.zh: 把可用食材和残余都直接堆肥

explanation.en: Use edible food where safe; separately route unavoidable scraps through an accepted service.
explanation.zh: 在安全前提下使用可食用食物，再单独按合适服务处理无法避免的残余。

label.zh: 与食物损失及浪费有关的全球年度温室气体排放

label.en: Only emissions from household food bins
label.zh: 仅家庭厨余桶产生的排放

label.zh: 本学习者的个人减排量

explanation.en: The estimate combines food loss and waste globally, not a personal saving.
explanation.zh: 该估计涵盖全球食物损失与浪费，并非个人节省量。

The current app year
label.zh: 当前 App 使用年份

label.en: 2022, with 2024 as the publication year
label.zh: 2022 年，并另注明 2024 年发布

label.en: Farms only
Retail, food service and households
Households only

label.zh: 学习浪费与气候的关系并思考行动

label.en: Counting returned containers without climate learning
label.zh: 只统计退回容器数量，不涉及气候学习

label.zh: 把测验成绩当作个人减排数值

label.zh: 已测量的食物节省吨数

label.en: Only packaging has used resources

label.zh: 种植和供应已投入土地、水和能源

label.en: All environmental impacts begin at disposal
label.zh: 所有环境影响都始于丢弃
